statement: theorem regret_variable (V : Domain (E := E)) (hV : Bornology.IsBounded V.carrier) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (hx₁ : x₁ ∈ V.carrier) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (hη : ∀ t < T, 0 < η t) (hmono : ∀ t, t + 1 < T → η (t + 1) ≤ η t) (hloss : ∀ t < T, SubdifferentiableOn V (loss t)) (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V.carrier) : regret V η loss x₁ u T ≤ (Metric.diam V.carrier) ^ 2 / (2 * η (T - 1)) + (∑ t ∈ range T, η t / 2 * ‖currentSubgradient (loss t) (iterate V η loss x₁ t)‖ ^ 2) - ‖iterate V η loss x₁ T - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η (T - 1))
